name: swifttill-pos-monorepo
description: SwiftTill POS V9 real database and auth foundation: Neon PostgreSQL, Prisma migrations, password hashing, token sessions, role/permission enforcement, and production-ready auth/db boundaries.

scripts.check: node --check apps/api/server.js && node --check packages/db/src/client.js && node --check packages/db/src/adapter.js && node --check packages/auth/src/index.js && node --check packages/storage/src/r2.js && node --check apps/print-agent/agent.js
scripts.db:schema: echo Prisma schema is in packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run check:web && npm run auth:smoke
